results.overview: Faced with the truth about Miori and Touko Kirishima, Sakuta must make a choice. This will be his final case of Adolescence Syndrome!

results.title: Lunok
results.overview: Astrid Lee and Allison Ross sizzle on screen as they play “dare two friends”, a sexual game that eventually reveals the true feelings they have been hiding from each other. Will they ruin their friendship and give in to their desires?

results.title: The Yeti
results.overview: When an oil tycoon and a famous adventurer vanish into the harsh winter of remote northern Alaska, a hand-picked rescue team endeavors to bring them home. What they don’t know is that they are trespassing on The Yeti’s territory, and the elements are the least of their worries.

results.title: Spit Or Swallow
results.overview: A story of sexual discovery. After a playboy breaks a virgin’s heart, her sexy professor ignites her world. But now they must choose: Spit on the filthy demand, or swallow the degradation?

results.title: Ebenezer Scrooge: A Christmas Carol Horror
results.original_title: Ebenezer Scrooge: A Christmas Carol Horror
results.overview: A horror take on the classic tale. When cruel businessman Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by ghosts on Christmas Eve, he will have to decide whether to heed their warning to change for the better or remain cold-hearted and merciless.

A quirky 29-year-old named Sathya embarks on an unexpected journey of laughter, unlikely friendships, and self-discovery. Through hilarious misadventures and chance encounters, he slowly sees life's bigger picture - its surprises, joys, and second chances.

results.title: Speed Demon
results.overview: Aboard a high-speed train, a nun who has lost her faith must perform her first exorcism on a possessed passenger hellbent on crashing the runaway train.

results.title: SI Yugandhar
results.overview: An honest cop's discovery of a mysterious body launches a high-stakes investigation, forcing him to uncover a dark web of secrets hidden beneath the city's surface.

results.title: The Bus: A French Football Mutiny
results.original_title: Le Bus : Les Bleus en grève
results.overview: This documentary revisits the French football team's controversial 2010 World Cup and the bus strike that sparked global headlines and national outrage.

results.title: Another Day
results.overview: Garance is a young actress, but not a star. She manages everything as best she can, valiant, cheerful, a soldier, and she finds in alcohol an unconditional fuel, a source of comfort. Garance changes her life and begins an eight-year journey of moves, work, encounters, parties and anxieties, joys and hardships… An intimate, friendly, and sexual revolution. But she consumes, more and more. Until the very possibility of death…

results.title: Ballistic
results.overview: When a soldier's mother discovers the bullet that killed her son in Afghanistan was made at the factory where she works, she sets out on a path of revenge against those responsible.

results.title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
results.original_title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
results.overview: A seventy year old widow recovers from a stroke in the care of his dysfunctional family. While his body is failing him, his libido still rages on – unwittingly sparked by the attentions of his daughter-in-law, a dancer with a shady past.

results.title: Cloud Girl
results.overview: The adventures of a young girl named Providence, who is entrusted with a magic quill that makes everything she writes come true. Faced with this incredible power, she has to choose between living her dreams and saving the world.

results.title: The Christophers
results.overview: The estranged children of a once-famous artist hire a forger to complete his unfinished works so they can be "discovered" and sold after his death.

results.title: Boonie Bears: The Hidden Protector
results.overview: After gaining magical powers from Nian, the legendary Year Monster, our heroes are transported to a magical realm to stop a world-ending crisis. Briar deals with losing his 'big brother' status after the others gain powers, leading him to stumble into a plot that threatens both the human and immortal worlds.

results.title: No Place to Be Single
results.original_title: Non è un paese per single
results.overview: A brilliant and intelligent love comedy that celebrates second chances and new horizons, starring a strong and determined woman who settles the score.

results.title: La Vénus électrique
results.overview: A painter in 1928 Paris, unable to work since his wife’s death, unknowingly participates in fake spiritualist shows staged by a carnival worker. As he regains his inspiration, she falls in love with the man she is deceiving.

results.title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
results.overview: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.

results.title: Busboys
results.overview: A pair of idiot friends believe that if they become waiters, all of their problems will be solved. They aren't entirely wrong, but they aren't entirely right.
